lines.text: Federal marshals march a handcuffed Diane Whitmore past a swarm of screaming reporters outside the glass tower.
32-year-old billionaire CEO Cole Whitmore stands at the head of the mahogany table, adjusting his expensive tailored suit.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: My stepmother Diane and half-brother Jake thought poison and bullets could steal the Whitmore empire.
The terrified board members lower their heads in absolute silence, recognizing true authority.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - PRIVATE ROOM - DAY

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - PRIVATE ROOM - DAY
24-year-old night-shift nurse Harper Lane rests against white pillows, still recovering from her near-fatal gunshot wound.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: I still cannot believe you own this entire hospital, Cole, and all I knew was a quiet mechanic.
17-year-old Mia Lane steps into the room, wearing her hospital gown and holding a sealed medical file.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: That is not even the biggest secret in this room, Harper, because the doctor just read my lab work.
Harper grips the white cotton blanket tightly, staring up at her younger sister with sudden anxiety.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Mia, what is wrong with your post-op blood work? Is your heart failing again?

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: No, it is not my heart, Harper, it is yours because you are pregnant with Cole's baby!
Cole drops his leather briefcase, rushing to the bedside with tears of sheer joy in his eyes.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: A baby? Harper, we are going to be a real family.
The heart monitor suddenly begins to emit a rapid, erratic high-pitched flatline as Harper gasps for air.
